title: Impact of High-rise Schools on Children's Social Interactions and Development
what_it_is: Impact of High-rise Schools on Children's Social Interactions and Development

sections.label: School open spaces for students
sections.summary: MOE provides open spaces in school campuses for student learning and development, exemplified by Valour Primary School's sky terraces, open areas and play facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In particular, MOE provides open spaces in our school campuses, to support student learning, as well as healthy social and emotional development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: One example is Valour Primary School, which was completed in 2020, with eight-storey blocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The school has various sky terraces and pockets of open spaces adjacent to classrooms at multiple levels, which allow students to interact, play and exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The second level of the school is designed as an open area, with (a) a parade square which doubles up as a play court, (b) a playground and (c) other outdoor learning spaces.
